03 / EVERYWHERE ELSE

Around the clock.

Pick a city to turn the globe and fill its coordinates. Clocks use civil time, including daylight-saving changes and half-hour / quarter-hour offsets.

⌖

One point, two notations.

The format switch changes the input fields and globe labels together. One degree has 60 minutes; one minute has 60 seconds.

◷

Lines aren’t time zones.

Each 15° meridian is one solar hour. Civil time zones follow local rules. Dots mark representative locations, not zone boundaries.

◐

Earth, right now.

The shaded hemisphere is night; the pale edge is the approximate sunrise / sunset line. All calculations stay in your browser.
